description: This source file defines the AdbSocket class, representing a socket connection used in the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) protocol. It manages socket interactions such as opening connections, handling messages, and communicating with an associated device.

classes.name: AdbSocket
classes.description: Represents an ADB socket connection, providing methods for opening the socket, handling messages, and communication with an ADB device.

methods.name: AdbSocket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket with a specific device and identifier.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a connection to a specified destination over the socket.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages received on the socket, handling different command types.

methods.name: sendReady
methods.description: Sends an 'READY' message to the device to signal readiness for communication.
